title: The Power of Leaders
overview: This course explores the fundamental distinctions between management and leadership, offering participants a comprehensive understanding of emotional intelligence and its role in effective leadership. Participants will delve into key leadership theories, with a focus on situational leadership, and will explore the leader's role as both a delegator and a change agent.
audience: This course is designed for individuals in middle and senior corporate roles who seek to enhance their leadership skills through deeper self-awareness. It is also beneficial for any employee whose responsibilities include delegation, leading, and managing change.
methodology: Participants will engage in group activities, psychometric assessments, and team exercises. The course also includes case studies, followed by group discussions and debriefings to solidify learning.
objectivesIntro: By the end of the course, participants will be able to:
objectives: Identify personal strengths and leadership styles through self-assessments
Explore various leadership theories, with a focus on situational leadership
Understand the core competencies of Emotional Intelligence (EI)
Define the role of a leader as a delegator and change agent
